editorial:
Imagine waking up with no memory of who you are, only to find out you are a top-tier secret agent for a shadow police unit. That is the life of Rei, a stunning and deadly assassin who does the dirty work the public never sees. The vibe here is very sleek and mysterious, blending high-stakes espionage with a lot of tension. You get to follow Rei as she navigates a world where she cannot trust anyone, and suddenly, she becomes the target. It feels like a classic spy thriller where the lead is always one step ahead, but the danger is closing in fast.

What really works is the pacing and the cool action scenes that keep you on your toes. The acting is solid, and the twists make the plot feel fresh even for a movie from the late nineties. While some parts might feel a bit dated, the suspense holds up great. If you love movies about lone warriors fighting against a corrupt system, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final act, Rei discovers that her own organization betrayed her to cover up their tracks. She uses her training to outsmart the rival group and the traitors within the Zero Department. After a big fight, she manages to take down the people who marked her for death. She ends the movie as a free agent, having reclaimed her identity and her life from the shadows of the police force.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves secret agents and revenge stories.
